R1095.rule: Apply `min-width: max-content` (TIMER_BOX_STYLE) to countdown, stopwatch and clock boxes so they stay at least as wide as their nowrap digits.

R1097.rule: Keep the Dark/Light switch a calculation derived from current colours, not stored state.

R1099.rule: To show a foreground session's datum, call `putSessionData`; to hide it, call `removeSessionData(key, datum)`.

R1102.rule: When generating a media session id, never produce an id at or below the last id the window has made.

R1103.rule: Keep generated media session ids in the format `s<base36>`.

R1104.rule: Give each foreground session its own distinct id.

R1105.rule: When adding a new per-session foreground kind, add it to `ForegroundSessionListKeyType` and its list.

R1112.rule: Countdowns and stopwatches start in the stopped state by default.

R1113.rule: A countdown to a date and time has no start/pause/reset controls and always runs.

R1114.rule: When a change affects only timing, update the clock in place and do not remount it.

R1115.rule: Round a countdown up while it is counting down.

R1116.rule: Round a countdown down while it is in overtime.

R1117.rule: Tick TimerClockController with a second-aligned setTimeout, never per frame, and do not tick while stopped.

R1118.rule: Drop stopwatch history readings under one second.

R1119.rule: Place the stopwatch controls and history list in StopwatchTimerComp, keyed by session.

R1121.rule: Never compute countdown or stopwatch state from a window's own copy.

R1122.rule: Do not change the unset keyField on the Free provider (LLM_PROVIDER_MAP.free) into a flag or a default.

R1125.rule: Do not list router models (kilo-auto/free, openrouter/free) as Free models.

R1127.rule: Removing a free model needs no extra steps beyond removing it.

R1128.rule: Record a ToolHostError's status in hostStatus, never in status.

R1129.rule: Before blaming a provider for a failed answer, read the chatbot window's console to see which URL failed.

R1132.rule: Have the Free risk warnings name the service and link to its own site, taken from FREE_SERVICE_MAP.

R1133.rule: Measure on the user's own servers (a shared registry server, Ollama) before measuring against Free models.

R1135.rule: When a Free model has been measured, tell the user the anonymous quota was used.

R1136.rule: When targeting the Full view button in CDP automation, address it by its panel (Presenter > Full view), never by the bare title.

R1139.rule: After restoring the widget size key to its layout default, reload the page.

R1140.rule: To reopen a single closed pane, tick it back open under View → Widgets.

R1149.rule: Do not import from 'react' inside src/graph-view/core/; a React import there is a bug.

R1150.rule: Keep src/graph-view/core/ free of React and of any import from elsewhere in src/.

R1151.rule: To add a second graph dataset, implement the GraphSourceType interface for it.

R1152.rule: To add a second graph dataset, add a lazy body component for it.

R1180.rule: Route anything a box shows that the dataset does not name through an optional source hook, never a direct app call from the surface.

R1181.rule: Resolve only what a menu is about to show, in mapInYieldingBatches.

R1182.rule: Build a box's right-click menu from the same handlers its buttons call.

R1183.rule: Read the neighbour count from countCacheRef; never re-count it.

R1184.rule: Pass the ORIGINAL right-click event to rows that open a further menu, so the menu appears at the pointer.

R1188.rule: Handle undo/redo keys on the focused panel, never on the window.

R1190.rule: Fit the graph after calling relayoutGraph.

R1216.rule: Drive the compressor through its own writer and reader; never use a Blob or Response.

R1217.rule: Never press a control that was matched only by a loose matcher tier; loose matches are for pointing, not clicking.

R1237.rule: The guide runtime must not import an app module.

R1238.rule: When restoring a tucked-away help window after a walkthrough, do not re-read `isMinimized()` to decide whether to restore it.

R1245.rule: Never evaluate help search by corpus top-1 results.

R1255.rule: Do not move the mouse to reveal a hidden control; force its :hover state (via revealHidden) instead.

R1256.rule: Do not check whether a control is hidden before requesting a reveal for it; request the reveal directly.

R1259.rule: For a control inside a closed auto-hide footer (.app-auto-hide), press the footer's three dots first to open it before interacting with the control.

R1260.rule: Clear window.__owaDomMatch before believing a live DOM match result.

R1283.rule: Make useKeyboardLayerClaim reference-count claims per layer.

R1289.rule: When running /owa-enhance-chatbot, grade the chatbot on the assistant the user's window is set to, reading that from the head row.

R1291.rule: When running /owa-enhance-chatbot against Kimi, expect 429 (rate-limit) responses from Kimi.

R1337.rule: Raise a language's meta.json version whenever its data changes.

R1338.rule: Put a language's locale and direction in its own meta.json.

R1339.rule: Do not edit anything outside a language's own folder when adding a language.

R1340.rule: Do not use en/open-lyric-locales.json as the generic list of languages.

R1346.rule: Do not reload any window when the language selected is already the one in force.

R1347.rule: When a language delete fails because files are still in use, light Apply instead of reloading the app.

R1348.rule: Ask the user before changing the help window's owa_language install so it does not reload.

R1349.rule: Await ensureLangPlugins() in a window before reading the locale.

R1350.rule: Import the chatbot and aichat pages only after ensureLangFiles('assistant.json') has run.

R1351.rule: In a test that reads getSupportedLangCodes() synchronously, await ensureLangPlugins() first.

R1352.rule: Ask the user before running npm run release:lang to publish the language catalog.

R1353.rule: Keep the packages' duplicate-key check as a single pass, not a nested O(n²) loop.

R1354.rule: Never set the dir attribute on the html element for the UI.

R1355.rule: Give content elements their own dir attribute instead of setting dir on html.

R1356.rule: Do not expose owa_language to the model.

R1357.rule: When a language is missing, offer Install it and Not now in the help window, and install only if the user presses Install it.

R1359.rule: Add a new chat string as a key in every language package.

R1360.rule: Bump the version of each language package when a new chat string is added.

R1361.rule: Translate every key in each language package, so that a missing key fails in dev.

R1362.rule: Give each language folder at least a meta.json, a flag.svg and a dictionary.json containing every key.

R1371.rule: During an iterative improve-and-push loop, push only after the touched files' own tests pass.

R1372.rule: After any code change, run `npm run lint` before the final hand-off.

R1373.rule: Never put a shared server's real address back into a window to make something easier.

R1374.rule: A new reader of a shared server's address must live in the main process, or read a fact main has already worked out.

R1375.rule: Never send a shared server's API key or real address to a window.

R1376.rule: Read the shared LLM registry once after initAi, never on a timer.

R1377.rule: Do not edit llm-info.json while it is open unsaved in the user's editor.

R1378.rule: Never copy a key out of llm-info.json.

R1379.rule: Never open extra-work/.env to look at its contents; use .env-example for its variable names.

R1385.rule: Do not open a real tunnel from a session; ask the user to start it in their own terminal.

R1392.rule: Never pipe `--raw` report text into an agent that holds the repo's credentials.

R1393.rule: Determine whether a tunnel is up from the machine and the site, never from an answer.

R1394.rule: Do not use the user's shared LLM server to run tests.

R1396.rule: Record null in model-benchmarks.json for any value that was not measured.

R1397.rule: When adding a benchmark run, also update the model's fit and fitNote in model-benchmarks.json.

R1398.rule: Describe machines in model-benchmarks.json by their description, never by their address.

R1399.rule: Never calculate a model's speed from the seconds of a whole answer, since those include prompt reading time.

R1402.rule: After editing a page, re-ask all the answers written from that page, not only the row the edit was for.

R1403.rule: After a page edit, ask every row of that page again rather than only the targeted one.

R1404.rule: Never put a date, a version number, or a count into the text a known question is asked with.

R1406.rule: Keep the last-reported server kind in lastServerKindMap so that a timed-out server look does not send the question out sampled.

R1407.rule: Read the languages of one long text row by row by its data type, never by the screen's Line Sync setting.

R1413.rule: Give a long text column's own style only its font and size.

R1416.rule: Do not take the Space key for a part button that is not lit.

R1417.rule: When turning on Atom mode for a long text already on a screen, re-put that text to the screen.

R1418.rule: Put lineCount in long text outlines, never the words.

R1419.rule: Never stack a long text that has only a single language.

R1504.rule: Remove the mermaid render id element only when rendering fails, not after a successful render.

R1505.rule: If the timeline wrap test fails, re-check whether the timeline break hints are still needed.

R1506.rule: Check the markdown file's size against the 5 MB cap before reading its bytes.

R1507.rule: Do not call require in the markdown preview page, which is locked down.

R1508.rule: Do not call run() or mount AppWindowToolsComp in the markdown preview page.

R1509.rule: Keep the markdown editor's text in refs rather than React state, to avoid re-rendering on every keystroke.

R1511.rule: Save markdown edits via fsWriteFile through the provider bridge, since the window is locked down.

R1512.rule: Do not add new translation (tran) keys for the markdown preview labels; reuse existing ones.

R1513.rule: Show markdown preview notes in an inline bar under the window head, not in a popup or toast.

R1514.rule: Have saveData refuse writes for read-only bible notes itself, not rely on the UI lock.

R1515.rule: Make the bible note window refuse verse item ids in both read-only and editable modes.

R1516.rule: Do not offer recolour, edit, or delete actions on verse rows in the Resources panel.

R1517.rule: Dynamically import the assistant-button dependencies at the moment of the press, not at load.

R1518.rule: In tests that render MarkdownPreviewAppComp, stub the assistant button.

R1519.rule: In tests that render ResourcesFileRowComp and open a note file, mock bibleStyleHelpers and BibleItemsViewController.

R1521.rule: Keep bibleNotePreviewHelpers.ts and markdownPreviewParamHelpers.ts free of imports.

R1522.rule: After driving the markdown preview with browser tools on a user's file, restore the file to its original contents.

R1523.rule: When updating a song or slide document, do not save the file; the update must write only to the editing history, leaving the document unsaved for a human to save.

R1527.rule: Keep the in-page destructive-label functions that PRESS_GUARD_SOURCE ships as source text self-contained.

R1532.rule: Never aim a regression check at a real Clear button; use injected probe buttons with a click counter instead.

R1540.rule: When adding a new label-aimed acting tool, give it the words check in checkToolCall.

R1543.rule: All modification files must provide an option to revert.

R1545.rule: Never widen the security policy for convenience.

R1552.rule: In the in-page script's template literal, write the escape \t as \\t with a doubled backslash.

R1591.rule: Preserve a message editor's ID when it is moved or edited.

R1592.rule: Do not derive a controlled input's value from the output of a lossy serializer.

R1593.rule: Draw the display's desktop wallpaper behind everything the mini screen card renders, in place of the checkered pattern.

R1594.rule: Do not change the wallpaper approach back into a desktopCapturer screen capture of the display.

R1599.rule: On macOS, get the wallpaper URL via NSWorkspace.desktopImageURLForScreen, called through osascript -l JavaScript.

R1601.rule: On macOS, resolve a .madesktop wallpaper to its thumbnailPath.

R1602.rule: On macOS, if NSWorkspace gives no answer, fall back to System Events 'picture of every desktop' matched by display position.

R1603.rule: On GNOME, read the wallpaper with gsettings.

R1605.rule: Do not have the main process query Electron's `screen` module to identify displays for the wallpaper read.

R1606.rule: Decode HEIC system wallpapers with nativeImage.createThumbnailFromPath, because nativeImage.createFromPath returns empty for them.

R1607.rule: Use nativeImage.createThumbnailFromPath only for files with image extensions, never for other types such as .madesktop.

R1608.rule: Share one wallpaper read per display among all cards on that display, and release it when the last card is gone.

R1609.rule: Copy the desktop's own wallpaper layout (Fill, Fit, Stretch, Centre or Tile) when drawing the wallpaper.

R1610.rule: If the wallpaper cannot be read on a machine, keep showing the checkered pattern instead.

R1612.rule: Do not release a drawing layer's root on unmount when `isPageScreen` is true.

R1613.rule: Make any ref callback that returns a cleanup stable with `useCallback`.

R1620.rule: Verify the modal and floating widget layering in the running app, not only through unit tests.

R1621.rule: Do not try to fix the model's inability to write valid Open Lyric by adding a longer prompt.

R1624.rule: When an [Instrumental] marker is encountered, recognise it and route it to the Breakdown section rather than treating it as a sung lyric.

R1625.rule: Never read a setting, a data-folder file, or a folder path at module scope in any code that a renderer entry imports statically.

R1626.rule: Read settings, data-folder files, and folder paths lazily, on first use after init() has run.

R1627.rule: URL-only facts, such as query params and isPage* flags, may be read at module load.

R1628.rule: When a bug reproduces only in the packaged app and involves a path, check for a read that happens before init() first.

R1629.rule: In init(), set the data folder before the first await.

R1630.rule: To determine which build a user runs, match the stack trace's file:line:col against `git show <tag>:<file>` rather than relying on the package.json version.

R1631.rule: In a test that does not want the real open-lyric, keep mocking it with vi.mock('open-lyric', …).

R1632.rule: Never import open-lyric in a test that runs in the node environment.

R1634.rule: In a test that imports the real open-lyric, include the `// @vitest-environment jsdom` directive.

R1636.rule: In a test that imports the real open-lyric, set document.execCommand to `() => false` with `??=` before importing the module under test.

R1637.rule: Dynamically import the module under test after applying the document patches, not with a static import.

R1638.rule: Never write a reference the user entered into the app or chat (a website, URL, song source, name) into memory, CLAUDE.md, skill references, manual sources, or tests.

R1639.rule: When an example needs a concrete value, use a neutral placeholder such as `example.com` or "Amazing Grace" instead of a user-entered value.

R1642.rule: Never write a home path that names a user account (e.g. `/Users/<name>/`, `C:\Users\<name>\`, `/home/<name>/`) into any markdown file or anything under `.claude/`.

R1643.rule: When referring to a sibling checkout, write it as `../<repo>` rather than an absolute home path.

R1645.rule: After every fresh npm install, run `node node_modules/electron/install.js` to extract the electron binary into `node_modules/electron/dist/`.

R1646.rule: To install dependencies in this project, run `npm run i:d`, which cleans the npm cache, installs, and runs the electron install step.

R1647.rule: After installing, verify the electron artifact exists before running `npm run dev`: check for `node_modules/electron/dist/electron.exe` on Windows or `node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app` on macOS.

R1651.rule: When adding a new converter option, verify it changes nothing else by exporting once with and once without it, removing the inserted text, and comparing the outputs byte for byte.

R1652.rule: On Windows, when comparing C# output against JS output, ignore `\r` characters because C# writes CRLF and JS writes LF.

R1653.rule: When implementing the on-screen check for a document (checkIsVaryAppDocumentFilePathOnScreen / checkIsVaryAppDocumentOnScreen), match only on filePath and never call varyAppDocument.getSlides().

R1654.rule: Keep any "is X on screen" predicate O(1) by checking the persisted on-screen settings map rather than doing per-call document parsing.

R1655.rule: When slide-level on-screen granularity is needed, use checkIsVarySlideOnScreen(slide) instead of document-level checks.

R1656.rule: In test mocks for getDataList, model an omitted id argument as "no id filter" so the document-level on-screen check is not silently broken.

R1657.rule: Every getter of a memoized on-screen setting reader must return a copy of the cached value, never the cached object itself.

R1658.rule: When defining a derived setting reader, list every setting the derivation reads in its settingNames.

R1659.rule: Never write through a nested value obtained from a memoized setting result, such as by mutating it in place.

R1660.rule: Do not use a TTL-only cache for memoizing setting reads; memoize on the raw setting strings instead.

R1661.rule: Before changing the setting memoization, add a test that switches payloads between reads.

R1662.rule: For subscriptions that only run a callback on screen events, use useVarySlideOnScreenChangeEffect instead of useScreenEvents.

R1663.rule: When the screen-id set is unchanged, useVarySlideOnScreenList must return the previous array instance, not a new equal array.

R1664.rule: When checking whether the screen list changed, compare only screen IDs and ignore payloads.

R1665.rule: Use the structure code P for Pre-Chorus parts, not PC.

R1666.rule: Use the structure code IS for Instrumental parts, not S.

R1667.rule: Do not add a number to parts whose structure code is marked ⟂ (Intro, Final-Chorus, Vamp, Outro).

R1671.rule: Never write placeholder values such as Unknown, C, 120bpm, or 4/4 for optional Config fields.

R1672.rule: Do not leave the Structure field empty.

R1673.rule: Do not reference in Structure a part that is not declared in the document.

R1674.rule: Do not give a numbered structure code to a ⟂ part (e.g., write O, not O1).

R1675.rule: Do not declare two parts with the same name.

R1676.rule: Do not leave unmatched [ or ] brackets inside a LYRIC fence.

R1678.rule: A '# Title' heading and free text outside fences are allowed.

R1679.rule: Write only chord-bar syntax inside Instrumental and Interlude fences; plain text there fails validation.

R1680.rule: Put free-text lyrics in Breakdown, Vamp, or Solo fences.

R1687.rule: Do not make owa_lyric_validate call open-lyric (validateMarkdownOlModel or api.document.checkMarkdown); keep the Open Lyric grammar written out in the tool's own code.

R1688.rule: Do not report a {p: #N} reference past the patterns listed in Config, or a section that Structure never plays, as an error; report it as a warning.

R1689.rule: Report an empty single-line Config field (such as '- Subtitle:') as an error.

R1690.rule: Do not flag an empty multiline Config field (such as '- Description:') as a problem.

R1691.rule: When a Structure breaks partway through, mark the reported play order as partial and do not say any section is unplayed.

R1692.rule: When exercising owa_lyric_validate end to end, call it through the app's own MCP host rather than running it standalone.

R1693.rule: When asked for presentingFlow (or run sheet / .owpf), run the presenting flow deep mode.

R1695.rule: In presenting flow mode, limit scope to the 69 rows PL-10, PL-29, PL-32..PL-76, and PL-81..PL-102.

R1699.rule: Build a fixture named zz-robot-<runid> for the run, and tear it down afterward.

R1700.rule: Give their own report lines to every screen action fired against a SHOWING screen (PL-72/74), the folded-sheet walk (PL-99), and the perf measurements with numbers (PL-63/70).

R1702.rule: Plan the scratch screen's teardown before starting the run.

R1703.rule: When tearing down the scratch screen, clear it layer by layer, hide it, re-Solo screen 0, and ask the user to delete it.

R1704.rule: When enumerating a font family's weights on Windows, call GetTypefaces() and drop faces marked IsBoldSimulated.

R1705.rule: Never use FamilyTypefaces to enumerate a font family's weights on Windows.

R1706.rule: Do not pass weight names such as `700 Bold` through tran().

R1707.rule: On a Mac or Linux robot run, before trusting the font list, open a text box's Font section and verify that the weight select lists more than Default for a multi-weight family.

R1708.rule: Fix the macOS/Linux font-list parser against real system output rather than synthetic test output.

R1711.rule: When the unverified-file confirmation appears during testing, leave it for the person to answer.

R1712.rule: To test the unverified-file path, use a file that the dev pack vouches for.

R1713.rule: To drive the native Open dialog in a live test, set the file box text to the path with WM_SETTEXT, then send WM_COMMAND with IDOK.

R1714.rule: When packing a release while a dev app is running, create the snapshot by copying the repo into release\rbsrc-<runid> with the robocopy command that excludes node_modules, .git, release, dist, electron-build, coverage, coverage-electron, test-results, extra-work\tmp, and extra-work\experiment-building.

R1718.rule: Unlink the node_modules junction before deleting the snapshot directory.

R1719.rule: Before deleting the snapshot, check with fs.lstatSync(p).isSymbolicLink() whether the node_modules path is a symbolic link.

R1720.rule: Remove the node_modules junction with fs.unlinkSync(p), not a recursive delete.

R1721.rule: After unlinking the junction, verify that <repo>/node_modules is intact.

R1722.rule: Only after verifying the repo's node_modules is intact, delete the snapshot with rm -rf.

R1723.rule: Never upload the test builds produced from a snapshot.

R1724.rule: Run test:electron in the repo, not in the snapshot.

R1725.rule: Run lint:all:error, test, and lint:es in the snapshot.

R1726.rule: Lint:pre and test:electron may be run in the repo while a dev app is running, since they are check-only.

R1727.rule: To compare the live tree with the snapshot, use cmp on each changed file.

R1728.rule: To fill a presenting flow, write the rows into the head file <file>.owpf.histories/<n>-head rather than editing the .owpf file on disk.

R1729.rule: Write JSON for the history head from a script file, not from an inline node -e command.

R1730.rule: When setting `widgetName` by hand on a panel, also set `widgetKey` whenever an English name exists for that panel.

R1732.rule: Before changing a DOM matcher that fails to find a panel, check that the panel has a name attribute.

R1733.rule: Verify a panel-related fix in both the open and the collapsed states before considering it fixed.

R1735.rule: Restrict scope matching to match tiers 0 through 2 only (SCOPE_MAX_TIER in domMatch.mjs).

R1736.rule: Before a live re-check of matcher changes, restart the server and reload the page, since the server caches the module and the page memoises the matcher.

R1738.rule: Never pass any flag to coverage-gap.mjs other than `--no-run`.

R1739.rule: Send focused coverage output to the agent's own `--coverage.reportsDirectory`, not to the shared report directory.

R1740.rule: Include `node extra-work/language-confinement.mjs <their new files>` in the brief given to test-writing agents.

R1741.rule: Put a test about one language in that language package's own `tests/` folder.

R1744.rule: In a scratch tsconfig, point the type roots at the repo's own node_modules/@types and name the node types explicitly.

R1745.rule: Type-check an electron test only through a scratch config that extends `electron.tsconfig.json`.

R1746.rule: Type a mock passed as a typed prop as `Mock<(value: number) => void>` instead of `ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>`.

R1747.rule: For a gap of about 400 uncovered lines, use six agents, each on a disjoint batch.

R1749.rule: Measure full-suite runs only when no agents are running.

R1750.rule: Build invisible or special characters at run time, or fix them afterwards, instead of writing them as escapes in file content.

R1751.rule: Confine agent file searches to `src`, `electron`, and `tools`, not `extra-work/`.

R1752.rule: Use a made-up language such as `xx` in any test fixture that needs a language.

R1753.rule: Never use an ASCII spelling of a real language's name in a test fixture.

R1754.rule: Put all file-path and file-name logic in src/server/fileHelpers.ts.

R1755.rule: At call sites, request path and file-name handling from fileHelpers rather than implementing it locally.

R1756.rule: Do not split paths on '/' at call sites; use fileHelpers instead.

R1757.rule: Do not call lastIndexOf(pathSeparator) at call sites; use fileHelpers instead.

R1758.rule: Do not keep a file-name sanitizer at call sites; use the fileHelpers sanitizer instead.

R1761.rule: All code other than start-up code must get path handling from fileHelpers.ts.

R1762.rule: Add new path or file-name helpers to fileHelpers.ts.

R1763.rule: When modifying a site that parses paths itself, route that parsing through fileHelpers.

R1764.rule: A test file that stubs ./fileHelpers wholesale must borrow the real rule from the original module using importOriginal.

R1765.rule: A test file that stubs ./fileHelpers wholesale must also set pathUtils.sep on its appProvider stub.

R1767.rule: When adding a separator to a path key before a prefix check, pass the result through toPathCompareKey.

R1768.rule: Never reintroduce a per-slide loop in the presenter's attached-background preload (preloadAttachedBackground); it must make a single file-scoped getAttachedBackground call.

R1769.rule: When deep-linking into an already-open or new popup window at a specific field, deliver the request through a short-lived setting that the target reads, rather than through a URL query parameter.

R1770.rule: The target popup window must read the one-shot request setting when it mounts.

R1771.rule: The target popup window must also read the one-shot request setting on its window focus event.

R1772.rule: Before calling openPopupWindow to open a popup deep-link, write the one-shot request setting (JSON with requestedAt, ignored after 30 s).

R1775.rule: A parent component that only selects the tab must read the request setting without removing it.

R1776.rule: When driving the pick over CDP, call Page.bringToFront on the picking window before evaluating the pick.

R1777.rule: When another window asks to open window X at thing Y, use this deep-link pattern.

R1779.rule: When adding a new raw reader or writer of data-folder text, route it through `fileHelpers` or apply the alias transform in the new code itself.

R1784.rule: Do not run the Repair Links operation automatically, since it reads every text file once.

R1792.rule: After the converter is updated, relaunch the app so the main process loads the new converter module.

R1794.rule: After any converter edit, repack the converter before a live check.

R1795.rule: After any converter edit, reinstall the converter before a live check.

R1796.rule: When PPTX conversion fails in the main process, check whether `node_modules/pptx-to-html-conv` is a symlink before investigating further.

R1797.rule: Before adding an import from a main-process module into `electronHelpers` (or anything a `client/*` preload reaches), check the new import graph's top-level code for `new Function`, `eval`, or a library that calls them at load time.

R1798.rule: If code that uses `new Function`, `eval`, or a library doing so at load is found in a preload's import graph, make it lazy (run on first call instead of at module load).

R1799.rule: To check for preload load failures, open the chatbot window fresh (not via reload) and read its console.

R1800.rule: When changing a rule for the presenting-flow archive export/import that is shared with the single-document bundle, make the fix in src/helper/appArchiveHelpers.ts, not in src/presenting-flow/presentingFlowArchiveHelpers.ts.

R1801.rule: When QA-testing the dropped-import pipeline for presenting-flow archives, simulate the drop with a CDP-fabricated dataTransfer whose File has appFilePath set to a real file on disk.

R1802.rule: Run-moving clocks (timeout and interval) must respond only to the preview's cursor changing, never to raw clicks or key presses.

R1803.rule: Do not change an interval so that a run moving somewhere cancels it; it is cleared only by its own off controls, the widget closing, reaching the end of the sheet, or the Next: Clear Interval action.

R1804.rule: When arming a time of day, refuse a time that has already passed today with the message 'The set time is already due' and arm nothing.

R1805.rule: Never roll a past time-of-day arming over to tomorrow.

R1806.rule: While a dueTime is set, each tick must re-read the remaining time from the wall clock rather than subtracting one per tick.

R1807.rule: When a timeout meets a running interval, lend the interval its count for one cycle instead of replacing the interval.

R1808.rule: A CC'd timeout borrowing a held interval's cycle must not un-hold that interval.

R1809.rule: Drop a borrowed cycle's dueTime when that cycle ends.

R1810.rule: When pausing a clock, clear its ticking rather than skipping ticks on a flag.

R1811.rule: When a countdown is paused, drop its dueTime.

R1812.rule: Show the pill as dashed while its clock is held.

R1813.rule: When a jump lands, do not fire another jump from that landing.

R1814.rule: Running Next: Clear Interval when an interval is already cleared must do nothing and show no message.

R1815.rule: Refuse Next: Clear Interval with the message 'Open the presenting flow preview to use this action' when no run is open.

R1816.rule: Next: Clear Interval must end only a running interval and must never cancel a timeout.

R1817.rule: Every code path that arms a clock must settle the preview cursor before arming, so the arming gesture cannot cancel itself.

R1818.rule: Keep arming paths settling the cursor before arming.

R1819.rule: When a repair writes back a shifted selection position, notify only the panel's listeners and not the run-moving notification.

R1820.rule: Never hold a run sheet or a document's slides in the auto-next helpers module; the run controller is registered from outside.

R1821.rule: When a run controller is unregistered, stop its clock.

R1822.rule: On each tick, settle the slot before stepping, then re-check the generation counter afterward and hand over the clock if it changed.

R1823.rule: Define firePresentingFlowRunAction in the auto-next helpers module, not in presentingFlowHelpers.

R1824.rule: Import PresentingFlowItem as a type-only import in the auto-next helpers module.

R1825.rule: Title each auto-next toast with that action's own label.

R1826.rule: Both the arming question and the arming setter must use the single PresentingFlowActionArmingType.

R1827.rule: When applying an arming, delete the other alternative (actionNumber or actionTime) so only one remains.

R1828.rule: A CC entry in a presenting flow must store only a uuid and optional screenIds, and nothing else.

R1829.rule: Every presenting flow entry must carry a uuid.

R1830.rule: Mint a new uuid with genPresentingFlowItemUuid when adding a presenting flow entry.

R1831.rule: When an entry is duplicated, re-key the duplicate with a new uuid.

R1832.rule: Never rewrite a presenting flow file just because a sheet was read.

R1833.rule: Give a legacy entry without a uuid one only when something first points at it.

R1834.rule: Read what a CC shows and sends from the entry it references every time, not from a stored copy.

R1835.rule: Re-arming a Next: Timeout element must re-arm every CC of it at once.

R1836.rule: Resolve CC references using the full list of presenting flow items, not a single item.

R1837.rule: Stamp each presenting flow row with a data-presenting-flow-item-uuid attribute holding its bare uuid.

R1838.rule: Every CC must have its own element in the sheet.

R1839.rule: When a payload is dropped from outside, append it at the bottom of the sheet first and then point the CC at it.

R1840.rule: When a row is dragged from another presenting flow, copy it in as a new element and point the CC at the copy.

R1841.rule: Append the element and attach the CC in one write, so a refused attach never leaves an appended line.

R1842.rule: When removing an element, drop every CC that points at it.

R1843.rule: Do not draw a CC reference that points at nothing.

R1844.rule: Never pass a CC to chooseScreenIds.

R1845.rule: A CC must ride the screens its host resolved to.

R1846.rule: Never pass an empty list as the preset when choosing screens for a CC.

R1847.rule: Key the screen-choosing latch by the native event, never by React's wrapper event.

R1848.rule: selectVarySlide must carry the same event across its setTimeout.

R1850.rule: A document entry's own CCs must ride with every slide of that document.

R1851.rule: Dropping a payload onto a row must attach a CC instead of appending an element.

R1852.rule: A drop onto a row must call stopPropagation().

R1853.rule: A drop with a null payload must not call stopPropagation().

R1854.rule: Add a new element only from the presenting flow name row or the empty state.

R1855.rule: When presentingFlowDraggingStore.current is set, resolve the drop source from the presenting flow by index instead of from dataTransfer.

R1856.rule: On an element row drop, the top and bottom bands set the position and the middle attaches.

R1857.rule: Holding Ctrl/⌘ forces a position drop and holding Alt forces an attach drop, anywhere on the row.

R1858.rule: When both Ctrl and Alt are held on a row drop, treat it as a position drop.

R1859.rule: An outside payload dropped on a row attaches unless Ctrl is held.

R1860.rule: Put the row drop handlers on PresentingFlowRowComp, not on PresentingFlowItemComp's wrapper.

R1861.rule: Slide rows and CC rows must attach the whole row on drop and never reorder.

R1862.rule: Fire a Next: Timeout CC from applyPresentingFlowCcItemsOnScreenIds before screen resolution, so it never asks for a screen.

R1863.rule: Refuse a Next: Interval as a CC.

R1864.rule: Decide whether a kind can be a CC by its canBeCcItem flag on the registry entry.

R1865.rule: A CC'd timeout met by a running interval must borrow its cycle rather than replace it.

R1866.rule: A Jump to host must treat its CC as a pointer to a target line, not as a follower.

R1867.rule: A Jump to host must have exactly one CC target, enforced in attachItemCcItem and again when reading ccItems.

R1869.rule: Clicking a CC row must reveal the element it points at, never present it.

R1870.rule: The preview's frame capture handler must skip elements matching [data-presenting-flow-cc-row].

R1871.rule: When migrating a real presenting flow, also migrate its .owpf.histories/<n>-head file, not just the .owpf file.

R1872.rule: Do not reintroduce a derived identity for presenting flow entries; use uuids.

R1873.rule: To take down both a live slide and its CC, use a clear action.

R1874.rule: Set `box-sizing: content-box` on the run-sheet gutter component (not border-box).

R1875.rule: Run-sheet rows that the run cannot stop on (CC followers, a document's slides, placeholders) must pass `lineNumber={null}` to the gutter.

R1876.rule: Run-sheet rows that the run cannot stop on must still draw the gutter so the rail stays unbroken and labels align.

R1877.rule: Indent nested run-sheet rows by `depth` after the gutter, never as row padding.

R1878.rule: Derive the tree row's run cursor from `usePresentingFlowPreviewIsItemSelected`, the same store the preview widget uses.

R1879.rule: Apply the run cursor as a class on the row, not as a prop passed into the gutter.

R1881.rule: Make run-sheet rows respond to Enter only, and do not add a Space handler to them.

R1882.rule: Change the run-sheet gutter in one place only, shared by the tree row and the preview header.

R1883.rule: After changing the run-sheet gutter, check both the tree and the floating preview.

R1884.rule: Make colour decisions for the run-sheet gutter follow the console design system tokens.

R1885.rule: When a presenting flow element drop onto another presenting flow's card is a no-op, re-add the element from its own list instead.

R1886.rule: Do not re-file the cross-presenting-flow drag no-op as a bug.

R1887.rule: When handling a drop onto a presenting flow row, call stopPropagation() so the drop does not also reach PresentingFlowFileComp.

R1888.rule: Call stopPropagation() on clicks inside the presenting flow tree so they do not bubble to the enclosing FileItemHandlerComp li.

R1889.rule: Pass every setting name the presenting flow persists through toPresentingFlowSettingName.

R1890.rule: Deliver presenting flow rows to a screen through dragStore.onDropped, not dataTransfer.

R1891.rule: Do not remove or simplify the subscription that makes PresentingFlowDocumentSlidesComp re-subscribe to its referenced document's update event and re-run loadVaryAppDocumentSlides.

R1892.rule: Keep the genTimeoutAttempt(500) debounce timer in PresentingFlowDocumentSlidesComp per component instance, not at module level.

R1893.rule: Do not treat the expanded-document stale-rows bug as PL-62, which concerns the .owpf file itself.

R1894.rule: Never key presenting-flow item rows by their array position or index; key each row by its entry's uuid.

R1895.rule: Do not change the behavior where two entries of the same document share one expansion setting and expand together.

R1896.rule: When arming a Keyboard Event run action with a shortcut, only allow Ctrl and/or Shift as modifiers, requiring at least one of them; do not allow Alt, Meta, or a bare key.

R1897.rule: Do not allow a bare key (no Ctrl or Shift modifier) as a Keyboard Event shortcut, because bare keys like ArrowDown or Space would step the run.

R1898.rule: Ensure each Keyboard Event shortcut is unique within a presenting flow, enforcing this in the PresentingFlow write path rather than at the question prompt.

R1899.rule: When duplicating an item or adding a CC from an item index, delete the actionKey on the copy so it does not retain the original's shortcut.

R1900.rule: When collecting presenting flow run shortcut keys, deduplicate them on read, keeping the first occurrence.

R1901.rule: The Keyboard Event run action must resolve screens by arming its CC followers and choosing screens, rather than only firing a run action.

R1902.rule: When a Keyboard Event run action has nothing attached, fall back to firing the presenting flow run action to show the toast.

R1903.rule: Register Keyboard Event shortcuts through the app's keyboard layer rather than a raw window listener, so modals can take the key back.

R1904.rule: When the presenting flow preview widget opens, focus it automatically so the operator's first key press is handled.

R1905.rule: Do not treat a Keyboard Event run action as a CC target host; its CC followers must not be targets.

R1906.rule: Include the Keyboard Event run action in the isScreenPinnable check so the pin is read for its followers' screens.

R1907.rule: When a lyric slide misbehaves, first check whether it is a structure slide or an appended attachment slide, before suspecting the stage document.

R1908.rule: Do not add toPresentingFlowMediaControl to PresentingFlowItem.validate.

R1909.rule: When a media-control field other than mode is absent, leave the existing value alone instead of applying a default.

R1910.rule: When the volume is unset, do not change the volume level the operator set by hand on the mini screen.

R1911.rule: When a media-control pin names a screen the host never reached, do nothing.

R1912.rule: Do not import the presenting flow from any module under `_screen`.

R1913.rule: When the slide changes, drop everything armed by media control, including pending pauses and timeupdate watchers.

R1914.rule: Keep one armed media-control controller per screen; a later controller replaces the earlier one entirely.

R1915.rule: The gear icon's click handler must call stopPropagation.

R1916.rule: In the presenting flow on-screen marking, use one module-level Set of subscribers with useSyncExternalStore per row, so each row re-renders only when its own answer changes.

R1917.rule: For presenting flow on-screen marking, use a single shared genTimeoutAttempt(500) debounce for all rows instead of per-instance timers.

R1918.rule: Call checkIsAnythingOnScreen() once in each of its two callers, never once per presenting flow file.

R1919.rule: Never call getSlides() from an on-screen check.

R1920.rule: Match marquee and message rows in the on-screen preset matcher on their text.

R1921.rule: Match time, camera, and screen rows in the on-screen preset matcher on their id.

R1922.rule: Match web, video, and image rows in the on-screen preset matcher on their filePath.

R1923.rule: Match fill and animation rows in the on-screen preset matcher on their src.

R1924.rule: Match countdown, stopwatch, and quick-text rows on a row key, stamping rowKey = toForegroundRowKey(data) on what applyForegroundDragData puts up and comparing it in the matcher.

R1926.rule: Never mark a PL presenting flow row as BLOCKED on the grounds that the panel is dev-only.

R1927.rule: Do not re-add the "dev only" caveat to a tutorial about the Presenting Flows panel.

R1928.rule: If a test run on a packaged build cannot find the Presenting Flows panel, report this as a real finding rather than treating it as the expected dev-only gate.

R1929.rule: In the presenting flow preview widget, Space, ↓, → and PageDown step the run forward only.

R1930.rule: Never wrap the run back to element 1 when stepping forward in the presenting flow preview.

R1931.rule: Gate the preview widget's step keys on focus being inside the widget (container.contains(document.activeElement)).

R1932.rule: Advance the run past a document element only once the cursor is on that document's last slide.

R1933.rule: When the run crosses into a document element, start at its first slide, even if a middle slide is still live.

R1934.rule: Step over a run line only when it is PARKED.

R1935.rule: Do not let folding a document element decide what is in the run.

R1936.rule: Dispatch the deferred slide-entry click in a later macrotask, not inside the commit that mounted the slide cards.

R1937.rule: Focus the preview widget itself when it opens.

R1938.rule: Never derive the run cursor from the screens; use the panel's own cursor (selectingState.childId).

R1939.rule: For a keyboard step, dispatch a click on the target card rather than calling handleVarySlideSelecting directly.

R1940.rule: Move the run cursor only on a click whose event.target has computed cursor pointer.

R1941.rule: Mark an element as selected only when both its key and its index match.

R1942.rule: Allow several presenting flow preview widgets to be open at once, one per file.

R1943.rule: Give slide cards inside the preview widget a restricted right-click menu limited to Show on Screens.

R1944.rule: Render Bible entries read-only in the preview widget.

R1945.rule: Measure whether the run element hangs off the bottom against findVerticalScrollingParent, not the preview's own container.

R1946.rule: Scroll the run's landing element into view with 'nearest', or center it when it hangs off the bottom.

R1947.rule: For presenting flow QA, inject test state into the `<presentingFlow>.owpf.histories/<n>-head` file, not the saved `.owpf` file.

R1948.rule: When a change to an editable document must show up in the UI, edit its `-head` file under `.owpf.histories/` rather than the saved `.owpf`/`.ows` file, then use Reload.

R1949.rule: Before blaming a cache for stale-looking editable document state, check whether the document is history-backed.

R1950.rule: When a document value looks wrong, read both the `-head` file and the saved file before drawing conclusions, since they can legitimately differ while the document is dirty.

R1951.rule: Never triage a cross-window propagation failure by asking whether the document was saved, because saving does not determine what readers display.

R1952.rule: When storing a duration countdown preset in a presenting flow, store its `durationSecond` value, not a resolved date.

R1953.rule: When storing quick text in a presenting flow, store its markdown source, not the rendered html.

R1954.rule: Keep the `dragStore.onDropped` closure path and the serialized `handleDragStart` foreground path producing the same result when a foreground is dropped.

R1955.rule: Make every `Foreground*Comp` drag button also call `handleDragStart` with a serialized `DragTypeEnum.FOREGROUND` payload.

R1956.rule: Do not snapshot the dragged slide JSON into a presenting flow entry; store a file reference (`filePath` + `id`) and resolve it at click time.

R1957.rule: Export and import presenting flows as `.owapf.tar.gz` archives using `tarCreate`/`tarExtract`, not zip.

R1958.rule: Never leave the old subsystem name anywhere in the project, including as a legacy constant.

R1959.rule: On any future rename, sweep every language folder under src/lang/data/online/ (dictionary.json, translated manual/, and questions.json) for the old term in each target language, not just English source and identifiers.

R1960.rule: Never rename the yt-dlp `--no-playlist` flag in src/server/appHelpers.ts or its assertions in appHelpers.test.tsx.

R1961.rule: Keep the word 'playlist' in RUN_SHEET_PATTERN in src/chatbot/helpBotHelpers.ts unchanged, since it matches what a user may type.

R1962.rule: Before any future sweep for a leftover old-name occurrence, check whether the match is a surviving lookalike (such as --no-playlist or HLS playlist terms) before changing it.

R1963.rule: When extending the presenting flow rename migration, extend its discovery logic rather than hard-coding the old name.

R1964.rule: Do not sweep up or rename lookalike 'playlist' survivors such as the HLS playlist references in electron/ files.

R1965.rule: Do not reintroduce the old word anywhere, including in the migration code, even for the migration itself.

R1966.rule: To add a new presenting flow action, append it to presentingFlowActionList and widen the PresentingFlowActionIdType type.

R1967.rule: To add a new foreground clear action, add an entry to foregroundClearMap.

R1968.rule: Decide separately whether to add a new presenting flow action to presentingFlowActionMenuList.

R1969.rule: Keep acceptedDragTypeList refusing PRESENTING_FLOW_ACTION_TYPE so that nothing else can produce a presenting flow action drag item.

R1970.rule: When storing a presenting flow action, store only its id (as {type:'action', data:id}), plus actionNumber for run-family actions, and do not store a captured title.

R1971.rule: Append actionNumber after calling tran() on the label, never include the number in the translation key.

R1972.rule: Reuse an existing shipped label for a new action when one fits.

R1973.rule: When a new action needs a label the app does not already ship, add the translation key to every language's dictionary.

R1974.rule: Narrow presenting flow items with PresentingFlowItem.screenAction or PresentingFlowItem.runAction, never by calling action.apply behind an isAction test.

R1975.rule: Route all presenting flow action items through sendPresentingFlowItemToScreens in presentingFlowHelpers.ts.

R1976.rule: Peel run actions off in sendPresentingFlowItemToScreens before calling armPresentingFlowCcPropagation.

R1977.rule: Colour new screen action icons to mirror the button variants of the mini screen's clear bar.

R1978.rule: Use --bs-gray-500 as the colour for actions whose clear-bar variant is secondary.

R1979.rule: Show on Screens and dragging onto a mini screen must keep overriding a pinned preset, so the operator always has a one-off escape hatch.

R1980.rule: When choosing screens, apply the precedence force, then preset, then selected screens, then menu.

R1981.rule: Every presenting path that presents a flow item or slide must also arm the CC followers.

R1982.rule: Keep screenChoosingHelpers.ts a leaf module; do not add imports to it that pull in the settings or file graph, such as a translation import.

R1983.rule: Pin getters should read defensively via toScreenIds rather than calling validate, which throws.

R1984.rule: A bad pin must never turn a presenting flow row into an error row.

R1985.rule: When a pinned screen is gone, show the 'Failed to apply to screen' toast and project nowhere; never silently fall back to the selected screens.

R1986.rule: Audio rows and error rows must not be pinnable.

R1987.rule: A document must be pinnable, even though it is never shown as a unit.

R1988.rule: When a slide's pin list is emptied, delete its key from slideScreenIds, and delete the map too if it becomes empty.

R1989.rule: Clearing a slide's pin must return the slide to the document's screens, not pin it to an empty set.

R1990.rule: Key per-slide pins (slideScreenIds) by slide ID, not by slide position.

R1991.rule: A slide with no entry in slideScreenIds uses the document's screenIds.

R1992.rule: When adding a Screen: Show or Screen: Hide action from the Add Action menu, ask the user to choose screens before the action line is written, and add nothing if the user cancels.

R1993.rule: When the screen checklist for a Screen: Show or Screen: Hide action is submitted with no screens ticked, refuse it with the message `Please choose at least one screen`.

R1994.rule: When saving a Screen: Show or Screen: Hide action with no screens selected, omit the screenIds key instead of storing an empty array.

R1995.rule: When sending a presenting flow item to screens for a Screen: Show or Screen: Hide action whose screenIds pin is empty, refuse with the same toast and do not fall back to the selected screens or show a screen-choice menu.

R1996.rule: When the Apply on Screens entry is used for a Screen: Show or Screen: Hide action, still ask the user which screens to use, and do not overwrite the action's screenIds pin.

R1997.rule: In the apply step of Screen: Show and Screen: Hide, read screenManager.isShowing first and only write it when the value needs to change.

R1998.rule: Give Screen: Show and Screen: Hide the same icons, colours, and ON/OFF badges as the mini screen toggle.

R1999.rule: Order the presenting flow Add Action menu as clears, then the FG group, then Screen: Show and Screen: Hide, then the run family.

R2000.rule: When formatting any .mjs file with prettier, run `npx prettier --tab-width 4 --write <file>` so the file keeps its 4-space indentation.

R2001.rule: After running prettier on a .mjs file, check `git diff --stat` to confirm the diff is limited to the lines you changed.

R2002.rule: Do not run prettier on whole files that were hand-wrapped and never prettier-clean (such as `llm-tunnel.mjs`); leave their formatting unchanged.

R2003.rule: When changing the flexSizeDefault of a pane that users have already seen, add a one-off migration for stored layouts, because a changed default is not applied to files that already have a stored layout.

R2004.rule: A one-off layout migration should write exactly what the Close Second Widget action writes, and should skip any layout that is already collapsed.

R2005.rule: Do not merge the helper functions of the Public Domain Songs plugin with those of the song-select plugin.

R2006.rule: To add songs to the Public Domain Songs catalog, append new records to publicDomainSongsData.json.

R2007.rule: Keep song texts in the Public Domain Songs catalog free of square brackets, backticks, and a leading //.

R2008.rule: Structure strings in open-lyric may repeat a section code.

R2009.rule: For a hymn with a refrain, declare one Chorus fence and repeat C after every verse in its Structure string.

R2010.rule: Do not re-file the listed presenter behaviours (blank first slide card, bible item replacing background, video time sync console spam, PDF full-width blank output, OBS Virtual Camera spinner) as bugs.

R2011.rule: When a QA observation looks wrong, read the source code before filing it as a bug.

R2012.rule: To QA the screen block without disturbing a live setup, present onto an empty layer.

R2013.rule: When presenting a bible item onto an empty layer for QA, note that the background will still change.

R2014.rule: Before trusting a measurement taken with a probe listener on the mini-preview video element, check that the element is still connected (`el.isConnected`).

R2015.rule: To confirm the contain path for a PDF slide with a blank projector output, switch On Screen Width to Not Full Width.

R2016.rule: After testing with On Screen Width set to Not Full Width, restore the original pdf-full-width setting.

R2017.rule: Whenever the app's knowledge changes, update the question corpus folder (tools/owa-devtools-mcp/questions/) in the same change.

R2018.rule: When the knowledge changes, add, reword, or delete the affected questions in the corpus.

R2019.rule: When changing a corpus file, bump its `updated` date.

R2020.rule: Before saving a corpus file, check `owa_app_state` to see whether an app run is up.

R2021.rule: If an app is up and someone is working in it, make the corpus edit the last write of the change and say so, or ask first.

R2022.rule: Do not conclude that saving a corpus file is safe from the process chain; judge it by the nodemon watch on tools/owa-devtools-mcp.

R2023.rule: Never write a second question matcher in src/chatbot/; reuse the shared ranking in questionMatch.mjs.

R2024.rule: After any edit to the question corpus, run questions.test.mjs.

R2025.rule: Reword a question's `text` freely when needed.

R2026.rule: Leave a question's `id` unchanged when rewording its text.

R2027.rule: Before adding text to a corpus page, check the page's length.

R2028.rule: When adding new text to a long page, put it on a page with room and file the row there with a `passage`.

R2029.rule: Write a question's wording so it asks what its page actually answers.

R2030.rule: For a row filed under a page over 6,000 characters with no control to go by, set its `passage` to a few words copied from the lead of the passage that answers.

R2031.rule: Give a row whose `find` is written early in a long page and explained later a `passage` naming the part that answers.

R2032.rule: When a passage lead is reworded in the manual, reword the matching lead in the corpus in the same change.

R2033.rule: Write recipes short enough (under 6,000 characters) to ride whole.

R2034.rule: File a question under the page that holds its answer whole.

R2035.rule: Set a corpus file's `focus` to the window keys declared in botFocus.mjs, using html base names rather than labels.

R2036.rule: Set `starterRank` only in a page file, never in common.json.

R2037.rule: Use starter ranks 10 and above when a focus: null file should lead one window without displacing another's curated four.

R2038.rule: Keep a question's `keywords` to terms a volunteer would type instead of restating the question text.

R2039.rule: Do not change the user's four remote-takeover decisions without asking the user first.

R2040.rule: When adding a new keying area that steps a screen with Space or arrows, register it with a priority and a `checkHasSelected` function.

R2041.rule: Make `checkHasSelected` answer from in-memory state only, and call it only on a key press, never to read or parse the DOM or document.

R2042.rule: When a focused keying area has a selected element, clear the rapid-press count.

R2043.rule: Exempt controls that use the arrow/Space key themselves (typing targets, range and radio inputs, video, audio) from the remote hand-over logic.

R2044.rule: Add new exempt controls to the central exemption list, not at individual call sites.

R2045.rule: When verifying live, send three `owa_press_key` calls in a row so they land within 1.5 seconds.

R2046.rule: Before presenting a slide to test the feature, note the screen's state, and restore it afterward.

R2047.rule: Startup code in renderer entries and boot.ts should import only dependency-light leaf helper modules, not broad modules that pull in document, screen, or React-server code.

R2048.rule: When adding storage calls to startup code, keep startup storage from loading the broad fileHelpers module.

R2049.rule: Import fileHelpers inside the method for rare asynchronous listing or deletion storage calls, not at module top level.

R2050.rule: When changing a renderer entry, boot.ts, theme, settings, or another helper used by all windows, build to the OS temp directory.

R2051.rule: When changing a renderer entry, boot.ts, theme, settings, or another helper used by all windows, compare the entry's recursive static JS imports after building.

R2052.rule: Do not treat a chunk name as evidence of which code the chunk contains.

R2053.rule: To determine what code a chunk contains, inspect the source map and trace the source import path.

R2054.rule: Before using a new react-dom/server export such as renderToReadableStream or resume, remove reactStaticMarkupOnlyPlugin from vite.config.ts.

R2055.rule: Before using an `electron` module from `electron/client/*` (the preload side), check which namespace it sits in by reading the `namespace Common` and `namespace Renderer` blocks in `electron.d.ts`, not the `declare module 'electron'` list.

R2056.rule: When a module is main-only, add an `ipcMain.on` handler for it in `electron/electronEventListener.ts`.

R2057.rule: When a module is main-only, add an `ipcRenderer.send` call beside the `ipcMain.on` handler in the preload side.

R2058.rule: To copy images from a renderer, use the web `navigator.clipboard.write` API rather than the Electron `clipboard` module.

R2059.rule: Before running git reset --keep in the shared worktree, save the output of `git diff --cached --name-only` and `git diff --cached --stat` so the staged set can be restored.

R2060.rule: Before running git reset --keep in the shared worktree, save `git diff --cached -- <file>` as a patch for every file shown as `MM` (staged in part).

R2061.rule: After running git reset --keep, run `git add` on the fully staged files again to restore their staged state.

R2062.rule: After running git reset --keep, apply each saved partial-staging patch with `git apply --cached` to restore partially staged files.

R2063.rule: After restoring the staged set following git reset --keep, compare the result against the saved `git diff --cached --stat` output.

R2064.rule: When a file staged by another session was also changed by your commit, stage it as the other session's staged version plus your committed hunks, not as their old blob.

R2065.rule: Never stage another session's file from its old blob when your commit also changed that file, because this silently reverts your commit's changes.

R2066.rule: Never use git stash in the shared worktree.

R2067.rule: Decide whether a .json file in a Resources folder is a link list by its content, not by its extension.

R2068.rule: Do not treat a .json file as a link list just because of its extension; check its content.

R2069.rule: If a .json file is not a valid link list or fails to parse, show it as a normal file row.

R2070.rule: Do not show a visible error or warning for a .json file that is not a link list.

R2071.rule: Allow only http and https URLs in resource links.

R2072.rule: Do not expand the allowed URL schemes beyond http and https for resource links.

R2073.rule: Validate the URL scheme both when parsing the link list and again in openResourceLinkUrl before opening.

R2074.rule: Read resource link list files on demand and do not cache their contents.

R2075.rule: Read a resource link list file when its row appears for a verse match.

R2076.rule: For a free-text search hit, read the resource link list file only on the first click on its row.

R2077.rule: Do not add a file watcher to the Resources scan cache; new files appear when the 10 s TTL lapses or on Refresh/Reload.

R2078.rule: Do not persist a Resources folder box's open/collapsed state; keep it as plain useState(true).

R2079.rule: Clicking a Resources file row must open it with the OS default app, never start a drag or a present action.

R2080.rule: Do not import genCommonMenu into the Resources row context menu.

R2081.rule: Show Resources scan truncation in the UI; never truncate silently.

R2082.rule: Never store the result of an abandoned (unmounted mid-scan) Resources walk in the cache.

R2083.rule: Never scan Resources folders deeper than two levels below the chosen folder (MAX_SCAN_DEPTH 2).

R2084.rule: Do not remove resources-search-showing when a Resources folder is removed.

R2085.rule: Persist the Resources folder list from the event handlers, not from an effect on dirPathList.

R2086.rule: Pass paths through escapeHtmlText before sanitizing the HTML body of a Resources confirm dialog.

R2087.rule: Draw the Others rows without canAutoExpandLinks.

R2088.rule: Verify a toggle of the Resources Others checkbox with a screenshot, not owa_click.

R2089.rule: Verify the Copy to Data Directory confirm's Yes press with a person at the window, since owa_click cannot press it.

R2090.rule: For the native file picker, verify with a person or the Win32 route, since no CDP tool can answer it.

R2091.rule: Add Files must never overwrite an existing file; pick a free name instead.

R2092.rule: Return a disk failure in the file-copy result instead of throwing it.

R2093.rule: After a disk failure during Add Files, delete the partial file and stop copying.

R2094.rule: Copy test setup from ResourcesDirBoxComp.test.tsx when writing tests for Resources components.

R2095.rule: Do not reintroduce a hover timer to reveal the origin of a presenting flow entry; the origin is revealed only through the Reveal Original context-menu item.

R2096.rule: Do not hand-roll a custom reveal mechanism for presenting flow entry origins; instead push genRevealOriginal(...) into the row's context menu.

R2097.rule: When the user scopes a robot test to a specific area, test only that area.

R2098.rule: Do not test the skill's mandatory blocks (screen, media download, drag-and-drop, locale) or neighbouring features (Export/Import Data, the KJV question, downloads) during a scoped robot test unless the user asks for them.

R2099.rule: Before adding a block or row to a scoped robot test, check whether it falls within the user's named area.

R2100.rule: Treat dropping a file into a chosen folder or copying to a chosen place as path selection, not as a media download or archive contents.

R2101.rule: When a fault is found outside the user's named test area, report it without investigating or testing it further.

R2102.rule: When the user asks for a report, stop testing and report what was run.

R2103.rule: When the user's own dev app is running and a live check needs a first-run state, start a second dev Electron on a scratch profile against the same Vite server instead of driving or emptying the user's app.

R2104.rule: Before launching the scratch instance, seed its setting.json with clientSetting selected-parent-dir pointing at the scratch data folder and stay-awake set to "false".

R2105.rule: Create the scratch data folder before launching the scratch instance.

R2106.rule: Before launching the scratch instance, write the select-dir-bible-notes setting file in the scratch data local-storage folder so note calls do not report that no Bible notes folder is set up.

R2107.rule: Before driving or killing a process, prove its pid is the scratch instance by checking its userDataPath.

R2108.rule: Match the userDataPath of the newly discovered process file to the scratch folder every time, rather than taking the first pid that is not the user's.

R2109.rule: After launching the scratch profile with --owa-open-chatbot, list electron.exe with its command line and stop any extra full app that came up.

R2110.rule: Stop the scratch instance by its pid before the session ends.

R2111.rule: Seed stay-awake to false in the scratch setting so the scratch instance does not hold the PC awake.

R2112.rule: To show a model's rare slip live, launch the scratch instance with OWA_LLM_REGISTRY_URL pointing at a small local stand-in model server, not a real model.

R2113.rule: Never start the scratch instance with `npm run dev` or `electron:build`.

R2114.rule: Grep the compiled electron-build .js files for a main-process change before relying on `electron .` to pick it up.

R2115.rule: When two apps are up, choose the scratch app with owa_choose_app by the pid whose userDataPath is the scratch folder.

R2116.rule: In scripts that import discovery.mjs, prove the target with a screenshot of a fresh-profile state before the first click.

R2117.rule: For the scratch instance, use the owa_* tools and do not aim any action by uid.

R2118.rule: Before every batch of owa_* calls, check the answer's content, not the pid list, to confirm it is the scratch app.

R2119.rule: When owa_* calls keep answering with the user's app, start a fresh stdio server pinned to the scratch port with OWA_CDP_PORT.

R2120.rule: Launch a scratch window with --disable-background-timer-throttling, --disable-renderer-backgrounding and --disable-backgrounding-occluded-windows so it stays visible and answers tools.

R2121.rule: For a picture of a scratch window covered by the user's window, draw the CSS in an offscreen BrowserWindow (show: false, offscreen: true) instead of using the screenshot.

R2122.rule: For a scratch window covered by the user's window, trust the DOM tools and the scratch data/local-storage files rather than its screenshot.

R2123.rule: To check a native dialog of the scratch main process, start the scratch copy with --inspect=<port> before the `.`.

R2124.rule: Never press a native dialog button by coordinates or SendKeys.

R2125.rule: When acting on a native dialog, aim only by the scratch pid, never the user's app.

R2126.rule: When a name box or confirm would need the person's answer, seed the state it would have made as a local-storage file and reopen the panel instead.

R2127.rule: Never press a control that asks a question in a hidden scratch Presenter window.

R2128.rule: Restore a hidden scratch Presenter's folder through the path box instead of pressing its confirm.

R2129.rule: Before the first launch, seed one child setting so the Set according paths prompt never appears.

R2130.rule: Create the folder that a seeded child setting points to.

R2131.rule: Seed local-storage in a second scratch data folder too, so switching to it loads without a used-folder question.

R2132.rule: Set a state the UI cannot reach without a destructive press in the scratch local-storage setting file, and read it back after Apply Settings.

R2133.rule: For a non-English pass, extract the packed language archive into the scratch data lang folder before the launch.

R2134.rule: Copy the user's KJV.xml into the scratch bibles-data folder so the Reader's Create the KJV Bible confirm never appears.

R2135.rule: Write every Windows path from node with path.win32.join or String.fromCharCode(92), not with backslashes in a quoted Git Bash node -e.

R2136.rule: Stop the scratch instance by its own pid.

R2137.rule: Before deleting the scratch folder, cd out of it so the delete does not fail with EBUSY.

R2138.rule: Default to the second scratch dev instance whenever a live check needs a first-run or destructive-ish state while the user's dev app is running.

R2139.rule: Before toggling Line Sync on someone's working app, tell them that the operator's grouped Bibles-tab panes and colour note will be rebuilt from the screen's versions and lost.

R2140.rule: To read a screen on a virtual display, which has no screen.html CDP target, open http://127.0.0.1:<mirror port>/vd/<n>/ in headless Chrome and read the vd-screen.html iframe.

R2141.rule: When renaming the Bible column class, rename the class and VIEWER_BIBLE_COLUMN_SELECTOR in electron/virtualDisplayProtocol.ts together.

R2142.rule: Do not import screenEventHelpers from the Bible column helpers (screenBibleColumnHelpers.ts); import registerScrollingSyncEvent from screenScrollSyncHelpers.ts instead.

R2143.rule: Derive the mini preview scale from the Bible div's two widths, never from a pane's own offsetHeight.

R2144.rule: Do not re-file the Ctrl/Alt+Arrow verse-stepping bug on the screen output, because it is already fixed on refactor22.

R2145.rule: Verify the key-to-output round trip live, not only through unit tests, when checking Ctrl/Alt+Arrow verse stepping.

R2146.rule: Present a verse and press F5 before the live verification of verse stepping.

R2147.rule: Use select_page to select the screen.html?screenId=N target during live verification of verse stepping.

R2148.rule: Press Control+ArrowRight during live verification of verse stepping.

R2149.rule: After pressing the key during live verification, read the new target from <data dir>/local-storage/screen-ft-manager.

R2150.rule: Do not put clear or sync-request calls in a React effect cleanup; trigger them from the toggle click handler instead.

R2151.rule: Do not merge `setupContainer` back into the per-frame `syncCanvasSize` render path; keep canvas creation and styling separate from per-frame resizing.

R2152.rule: Never call `saveDrawData` on each pointer move; save only on committed events.

R2153.rule: Call `saveDrawData` only for committed events (stroke-complete, undo, redo, clear, enable, disable, and receiveSyncScreen sync/commit/clear).

R2154.rule: Every local send must call `ScreenDrawManager.enableSyncGroup(this.screenId)` first, so the screen's outgoing draws are not blocked by the echo guard.

R2155.rule: Read overlay focus from `canvas.getRootNode().activeElement`, not `document.activeElement`, because the overlay lives in a shadow root.

R2156.rule: In tests that draw strokes with synthetic pointer events, issue two pointer-downs or call `focus()` first.

R2157.rule: Do not call `preventDefault()` in the palette shortcut handler, so other overlay panels' listeners still run.

R2158.rule: Keep the palette shortcut bindings in sync with the button titles by generating the titles via `toShortcutTitle`.

R2159.rule: Give every palette panel button `onMouseDown={handleKeepOverlayFocus}` so clicking a button does not move focus off the canvas.

R2160.rule: Resolve the key in `checkIsDrawShortcutKey` with `KeyboardEventListener.toEnUsKey(event)`, not `event.key`.

R2161.rule: Do not bind undo or redo in the draw panel; the canvas keydown handler already consumes those keys.

R2162.rule: The panel may keep its setPaintTool arming logic in a React effect because it is local and idempotent.

R2163.rule: Do not drive the render-quality toggle from a React effect; call `setRenderQuality` from the handler.

R2164.rule: When creating an eraser stroke, force `isStraight`, `is3D` and `isDots` to false.

R2165.rule: Make `handlePointerDown` return early when `event.button !== 0`, so right-clicks do not start a stroke.

R2166.rule: If cross-resolution group members ever need correct stroke placement, switch draw coordinates to normalized 0..1 values.

R2167.rule: Gate both the palette shortcuts and `handlePointerDown` on `ScreenDrawManager.isFocused`.

R2168.rule: Make `isFocused` also require `document.hasFocus()`, so a window reactivation click does not register as a stroke.

R2169.rule: Send a full `sync` snapshot only on initialization or screen show, never per move.

R2170.rule: When receiving a sync message, clone the incoming data instead of keeping shared object references.

R2171.rule: Store stroke coordinates in native screen pixels of the source screen.

R2172.rule: When disabling draw, clear the shared drawing only if no other sync-group member still has `isDrawEnabled`.

R2173.rule: In draw's `receiveSyncScreen`, call `forwardToOwnScreenOutput(data)` so the screen's own output window receives group updates.

R2174.rule: To add a new draw mode, extend `DrawDataType`.

R2175.rule: To add a new draw mode, add its render logic and a sync action.

R2176.rule: Do not call `stopPropagation()` on the canvas merely because it has focus; only do it while a stroke is in progress.

R2177.rule: Do not persist the transient `isEraser` panel state.

R2178.rule: Read `screenDrawManager?.isDrawEnabled` with optional chaining, because preview test mocks may lack `screenDrawManager`.

R2179.rule: Do not merge the focus spotlight back into the draw overlay's stroke list or rendering; keep it as its own layer.

R2180.rule: When adding overlay plumbing, extend the shared modules (screenOverlayHelpers.ts and miniScreenOverlayControlComps.tsx) rather than copying the code into a new overlay.

R2181.rule: Keep the clear and dim colour stops of the focus mask gradient the same hue.

R2182.rule: Use the dim colour at alpha 00 (#rrggbb00) as the clear gradient stop, never the transparent keyword.

R2183.rule: Do not render the moving spotlight hole with a box-shadow; use the radial-gradient background on the overlay div.

R2184.rule: Do not use a canvas to render the focus spotlight.

R2185.rule: Coalesce focus overlay repaints through requestAnimationFrame (genFrameScheduler) rather than repainting on every pointermove.

R2186.rule: Cache the overlay rect for the duration of a press-and-hold gesture so that moves do no layout.

R2187.rule: Listen for pointermove, pointerup and pointercancel at window level, not on the overlay div, so a drag that leaves the preview still ends correctly.

R2188.rule: Set touch-action: none on the focus overlay div.

R2189.rule: Enable spotlight pointer interaction only on the presenter (when !appProvider.isPageScreen).

R2190.rule: Throttle spotlight move messages to 40ms on the wire.

R2191.rule: Never throttle spotlight moves applied locally.

R2192.rule: Call enableSyncGroup(screenId) before every local send from the focus screen.

R2193.rule: In receiveSyncScreen, forward incoming focus state to the screen's own output with forwardToOwnScreenOutput.

R2194.rule: Validate dimColor as #rrggbb by regex on every entry (disk, wire, input), falling back to #000000 when invalid.

R2195.rule: Do not attach handleKeepOverlayFocus to the dim colour swatch.

R2197.rule: Write isPanelOpen only on the explicit toggle click.

R2198.rule: Switching the control mode must not change the enabled state; it only re-homes the state to the new mode's panel.

R2199.rule: When turning the toggle off, call setIsPanelOpen(false) and disableDraw().

R2200.rule: Seed the panel-open state from the manager that owns the restored mode.

R2201.rule: On restart, restore only the panel-open state and keep isSpotlighting false.

R2202.rule: Call disableDraw() when the toggle is turned off, regardless of which mode is showing.

R2203.rule: Gate only the enable path on the control mode; never gate the disable path.

R2204.rule: Arm and disarm the focus overlay in a mount effect, not via enable/disable.

R2205.rule: When disarming the focus overlay, always clear the dim mask.

R2206.rule: Attach onMouseDown={handleKeepOverlayFocus} to every focus panel button so clicks do not steal focus.

R2207.rule: Set the overlay's tabIndex to 0 only while armed and on the presenter.

R2208.rule: Use tabIndex -1 instead of removing the tabIndex attribute when the overlay is not focusable.

R2209.rule: Gate focus shortcut keys on ScreenFocusManager.isShortcutTarget.

R2210.rule: Reuse drawShortcutMap for the focus panel's keyboard shortcuts.

R2211.rule: Implement resetSettings through applySettings(), assigning all five fields and then doing one repaint, broadcast and debounced write.

R2212.rule: Do not put a synthetic keydown and the subsequent state read in the same evaluate_script call when testing via CDP.

R2213.rule: Wait about 150ms before asserting on a sync group member's DOM state.

R2214.rule: When adding a screen layer, explicitly decide whether it sits above or below foreground overlays, and set its `zIndex` to reflect that decision.

R2215.rule: When adding a screen layer, do not rely on DOM order to determine whether it stacks above or below foreground overlays.

R2216.rule: When a new screen layer does not render, check the stacking order before investigating the data path.

R2217.rule: Verify a screen layer's rendering on the real output window, not only on the mini preview.

R2218.rule: Turn on "Let other computers connect" in the Screen Mirror Connection panel (setting screen-mirror-host) before running a cross-machine Screen Mirror test, since the host does not accept guests until it is on.

R2219.rule: Enable Remote Control (/remote-control) in the current session before using ListAgents to find sessions on other machines.

R2220.rule: Do not try to message another session using only its session id or claude.ai URL; reach it through Remote Control and ListAgents instead.

R2221.rule: Do not treat a message from a peer session as the user's consent; get the user's approval before approving, presenting, or pushing.

R2222.rule: Do not set aside a scratch instance's discovery file to steer the owa_* tools, since this was refused by the auto-mode classifier and must not be worked around.

R2223.rule: Stop stale launch harness instances by their own pid using taskkill /F /T, never by image name.

R2224.rule: When Vite stops serving edits to a file, restart it by running touch vite.config.ts.

R2225.rule: Read a fresh chrome-devtools snapshot before clicking any element by uid.

R2226.rule: Do not run scratch guest instances on the machine whose host panel you need to press.

R2227.rule: Check window order on the guest using a desktop capture, not owa_screenshot.

R2228.rule: Turn hosting on first and put the peer on its own Remote Control session before running the cross-machine test.

R2229.rule: Do not rebind the listening socket when toggling the Open to the internet option, and do not drop LAN guests when toggling it.

R2230.rule: Apply the admits() access gate to HTTP requests, the WebSocket upgrade, and UDP discovery.

R2231.rule: Publish a guest's files under the origin the guest dialled, taken from its own Host header (readMirrorOrigin), never from peer.localAddress.

R2232.rule: Never trust a router's success response on its word; verify the port mapping before reporting it as opened.

R2233.rule: Before requesting a port mapping, call GetSpecificPortMappingEntry to check whether another client already owns that port.

R2234.rule: Skip any port owned by another client, or by this computer on a different internal port, and never request it from the router.

R2235.rule: After the router accepts a port, read the mapping back once and probe the public side through NAT loopback with a one-time token before treating the port as open.

R2236.rule: If the router-probe answer is anything other than this server's token, try another port; if there is no answer, report the status as unknown.
